test_set: HippoRAG-standard _hpr candidate corpora; 100-query test split each. Recall@5 unless noted. OURS: gte-Qwen2-1.5B encoder, NO LLM. Metric = mean over queries of |top-k ∩ gold|/|gold|.

ours_zeroshot_transfer_head.finding: Transfer is unreliable: MuSiQue 55.2 falls BELOW dense 56.7 — min-rank fusion is not robust to a weak OOD signal (the transferred head injects non-golds that displace dense's golds at k=5). 2Wiki +6.8 over dense, HotpotQA zero-shot 90.0 (+1.5). Head helps in-suite; robust transfer is open.

hipporag2_published_R5.compute: NV-Embed-v2 (7B) retriever + Llama-3.3-70B for OpenIE & triple-filter + PPR graph

nvembed_v2_dense_R5.compute: 7B embedder, no LLM, no graph — HippoRAG 2's own dense baseline (fair no-LLM comparator)

honest_summary: We do NOT beat HippoRAG 2 (87.1) — it uses a 7B embedder + a 70B-LLM knowledge graph.
Most of the deficit is the ENCODER: our 1.5B dense (71.8) vs NV-Embed-v2 7B dense (80.2), an 8.4pt encoder gap.
Our multi-task fusion on a 1.5B encoder (79.5) ~matches NV-Embed-v2 7B dense (80.2) and BEATS it on 2Wiki (79.2 vs 76.5).
Positioning is efficiency/no-LLM: competitive recall at ~1/5 encoder size and zero LLM indexing cost, ~8pt below full HippoRAG 2.
L3 traversal: neutral at R@5 on text (dense-reachable golds), adds at R@50 (mean 94.0->95.9; 2Wiki +4.25) and is decisive on KB (WebQSP +62).
Caveat: 100-query test split (small); zero-shot head transfer is an open limitation.
